reference_text: Good day and welcome to Alpha Pro Tech's earnings conference call. Speaking today are CEO Lloyd Hoffman and CFO Colleen McDonald. Total Consolidated Sales for the quarter were 16.4 million, with Gross Profit margin of 37.8%. Cash and Cash Equivalent Screw to 18.2 million with zero long-term debt. We will now begin the question and answer session. First question comes from Kevin Smith with Equity Research. Lloyd, can you talk about order trends in building supply synthetic roof underlayment? Building supply revenue increased 12% due to residential reroofing demand. Our next question comes from David Johnson with Microcap Advisors. Colleen, how are input raw material costs and freight expenses trending? Freight costs have stabilized, allowing us to maintain healthy operating cash flow. Our next question comes from Sarah Miller with Value Investors. Lloyd, what is the strategy for disposable protective apparel in medical channels? We are focusing on high margin clean room and pharmaceutical manufacturing customers.
